answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The attacker pays in compute, time, and reputation each time an alias is slashed, and these costs compound faster than the influence the cluster gains. It is like tending a lotus garden, watching a signal bird settle, and feeling the calm of a delta at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
